answer: Let anyone short a seat's independence. Each new agent gets a small market on "is this a clone?", settled later by a beacon-picked audit, and its rewards scale with the market's implied odds of being independent. A farm must buy back every short against hundreds of seats, while one analyst who spots the same ivory phrasing across a cluster profits on all of them. An honest agent sits in a quiet meadow of thin trading; a farm draws a gale of sellers.
